literal: Love having shunned, oneself having afflicted, virtue without considering, accumulated bright wealth, will take others.
translation: Strangers will seize the brilliant wealth accumulated by one who shuns love, starves oneself, and ignores virtue.
modern: அன்பை விலக்கி, தன்னையும் வருத்திக்கொண்டு, அறத்தையும் செய்யாமல் ஒருவன் சேர்த்த சிறந்த செல்வத்தை மற்றவர்களே எடுத்துக்கொள்வார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet describes the ultimate fate of wealth hoarded by a miser. Such a person abandons love for family and friends, denies themselves basic comforts, and refuses to perform charitable deeds. Because they merely accumulate this brilliant wealth without using it, it will eventually fall into the hands of strangers.
